notes: The flagship dataset intentionally publishes reviewed listening aggregates; it does not contain raw export rows.
Platform telemetry is reduced to broad device families; raw models, versions, user-agent strings and device identifiers are omitted.
Snapshot freshness separates the listening-event period, build time, enrichment evidence and dated Pulse; liveConnection is false.
The 6,593 value counts exact archive-name catalog entries, not 6,593 verified people. 182 normalized name-variant groups remain preserved until an evidence-reviewed identity migration.
The 2026-08 refresh replayed the complete Spotify extended history, a fresh Last.fm export and a new YouTube Takeout, extending the archive from 2026-07-03 to 2026-08-06 and adding 180 artists.
Every exact-granularity section must be reviewed again before a refreshed public dataset is committed.
Visitor imports remain browser-local and are not covered by this public-bundle manifest.
